messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate “The Facility: Null” as a playable browser survival-horror game, including progression, endings, and a JPEG no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- German-default interface with German/English localization; voice recordings remain in English.
- Include the dark medical facility, intro, lore, equipment, progression, co-op lobby flows, and win/lose conditions.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Decisions
- Build a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js.
- Local lobbies must not imply real online matchmaking; network multiplayer requires a hosted backend.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented menus, settings, lobby, intro, HUD, procedural facility, interactions, progression objectives, AI, controls, and game-state wiring.
- Earlier browser test confirmed the journal advances the objective and the security-panel interaction unlocks the gate.
- Confirmed browser movement works in a focused test: W moved the player forward and D moved right.
- Confirmed `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg` is a 1280×720 JPEG.

### Active
- Diagnose why the latest progression test moves far less than expected and cannot reach the MED keycard.
- Identify the browser 404 URL and fix it if appropriate.

### Blocked
- True network matchmaking and online multiplayer require a hosted backend.

## Next Move
1. Run `/tmp/opencode/facility-diagnose.mjs` to inspect key state and movement frame-by-frame; determine why movement stalls around the starting area.
2. Fix the movement or test setup issue, then validate keycards, gates, generator, elevator countdown, and endings.
3. Identify the 404 from request/response diagnostics, fix if appropriate, and rerun browser error checks.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-diagnose.mjs`: Newly created Playwright diagnostics for movement and exact 404 URL.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs`: Progression test; fails before reaching the MED keycard.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-move-debug.mjs`: Focused keyboard-movement test; previously confirmed W and D movement.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-errors.mjs`: Browser HTTP/console error check; reports a generic 404.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg`: Verified 1280×720 JPEG.
- `src/game.js`: Movement/collision, interactions, progression, AI, rendering, and debug API.
- `index.html`: Menus, lobby, intro, HUD, and ending screens.
- `style.css`: Presentation and responsive styling.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and appear as untracked in `git status --short`.
- Browser checks use `http://127.0.0.1:8000/`.
- The failed progression test’s movement helpers press keyboard keys for estimated durations, but reported positions advance only slightly; e.g. after targeting `(-4,-19)`, the player was at approximately `(-0.61,0,-4.74)`.
- Starting position is `[0,0,2.4]`; desk near `[0,.82,4.4]` blocks direct travel forward. Journal is at `[0.15,1.1,4.38]`; security panel at `[2.4,1.25,-5.7]`.
- MED, LAB, and REACTOR keycards are at `[-4,0.9,-19]`, `[4,0.95,-42]`, and `[-3,0.95,-55]`; generator at `[4,1.2,-62]`.
- Elevator call requires power and starts a 60-second survival countdown; return to its panel after the timer to win.
- Latest browser check reported `Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (File not found)` without a URL.

## Objective
- Complete and validate “The Facility: Null” as a playable browser survival-horror game, including progression, endings, and a JPEG no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- German-default interface with German/English localization; voice recordings remain in English.
- Include the dark medical facility, intro, lore, equipment, progression, co-op lobby flows, and win/lose conditions.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Decisions
- Build a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js.
- Local lobbies must not imply real online matchmaking; network multiplayer requires a hosted backend.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented menus, settings, lobby, intro, HUD, procedural facility, interactions, progression objectives, AI, controls, and game-state wiring.
- Earlier browser test confirmed the journal advances the objective and the security-panel interaction unlocks the gate.
- Confirmed browser movement works in a focused test: W moved the player forward and D moved right.
- Confirmed `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg` is a 1280×720 JPEG.
- Identified the reported 404 as the browser’s automatic request for `/favicon.ico`, not a game asset failure.

### Active
- Diagnose progression-test movement/pathing issue: the player’s route from the desk area stalls near the starting area, preventing the MED keycard test from completing.
- Determine whether to add a favicon or otherwise suppress the benign `/favicon.ico` 404.
- Once movement/pathing is understood, validate keycards, gates, generator, elevator countdown, and endings.

### Blocked
- True network matchmaking and online multiplayer require a hosted backend.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `moveAxis()` and the room/desk colliders to explain why the diagnostic player stalls near `x≈-3.59`; verify a viable route around the starting desk.
2. Fix any confirmed movement/collision issue, then rerun progression tests for keycards, gates, generator, elevator countdown, and endings.
3. Optionally add a favicon to eliminate the automatic 404, then rerun browser error checks.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-diagnose.mjs`: Playwright diagnostics; logs position and identifies the `/favicon.ico` 404.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs`: Progression test; fails before reaching the MED keycard.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-move-debug.mjs`: Focused keyboard-movement test; previously confirmed W and D movement.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-errors.mjs`: Browser HTTP/console error check.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg`: Verified 1280×720 JPEG.
- `src/game.js`: Movement/collision, interactions, progression, AI, rendering, and debug API.
- `index.html`: Menus, lobby, intro, HUD, and ending screens.
- `style.css`: Presentation and responsive styling.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and appear as untracked in `git status --short`.
- Browser checks use `http://127.0.0.1:8000/`.
- The progression test presses keys for estimated durations; it fails to reach the MED card at `[-4,0.9,-19]`, ending around `[-0.61,0,-4.74]`.
- The latest diagnostic confirms A/W input is registered and position changes, but movement intermittently advances much less than expected; at one point A movement stalls near `x=-3.59`.
- Starting position is `[0,0,2.4]`; desk collider is centered near `[0,.82,4.4]`. Journal is at `[0.15,1.1,4.38]`; security panel at `[2.4,1.25,-5.7]`.
- MED, LAB, and REACTOR keycards are at `[-4,0.9,-19]`, `[4,0.95,-42]`, and `[-3,0.95,-55]`; generator at `[4,1.2,-62]`.
- Elevator call requires power and starts a 60-second survival countdown; return to its panel after the timer to win.
- `roomShell()` creates central openings at room ends; `makeDoor()` places gates across them. `moveAxis()` is at `src/game.js:164`.
- The only identified 404 is `http://127.0.0.1:8000/favicon.ico`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate “The Facility: Null” as a playable browser survival-horror game, including progression, endings, and a JPEG no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- German-default interface with German/English localization; voice recordings remain in English.
- Include the dark medical facility, intro, lore, equipment, progression, co-op lobby flows, and win/lose conditions.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Decisions
- Build a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js.
- Local lobbies must not imply real online matchmaking; network multiplayer requires a hosted backend.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented menus, settings, lobby, intro, HUD, procedural facility, interactions, progression objectives, AI, controls, and game-state wiring.
- Earlier browser tests confirmed journal progression, security-panel interaction, and W/D movement individually.
- Confirmed `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg` is a 1280×720 JPEG.
- Confirmed `/favicon.ico` requests produce browser 404s; no favicon fix has been made.

### Active
- Fix movement/collision pathing so progression testing can reach keycards and finish the game.

### Blocked
- True network matchmaking and online multiplayer require a hosted backend.

## Next Move
1. Inspect and fix movement/collision behavior in `moveAxis()`; the latest progression test moves far less than expected and stalls near the starting area.
2. Rerun progression tests for keycards, gates, generator, elevator countdown, and endings after fixing movement.
3. Optionally add a favicon to eliminate automatic `/favicon.ico` 404s, then rerun browser error checks.

## Relevant Files
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs`: progression test; currently fails before reaching the MED keycard.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-diagnose.mjs`: diagnostic script logging player movement and colliders.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-move-debug.mjs`: focused keyboard-movement test.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-errors.mjs`: browser HTTP/console error check.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg`: verified 1280×720 JPEG.
- `src/game.js`: movement/collision, interactions, progression, AI, rendering, and debug API.
- `index.html`: menus, lobby, intro, HUD, and ending screens.
- `style.css`: presentation and responsive styling.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and appear as untracked in `git status --short`.
- Browser tests use `http://127.0.0.1:8000/`.
- Latest progression test output showed expected position `[-4,-19]` but actual `[-0.73,0,-3.88]`; MED keycard assertion failed.
- `moveAxis()` checks each axis against all colliders using `hx=c.w/2+.32`, `hz=c.d/2+.32`; the security gate at `z=-6.45` remains solid until unlocked.
- The security-panel collider is at `[3.55,0,-13]`; MED, LAB, and REACTOR cards are at `[-4,0.9,-19]`, `[4,0.95,-42]`, and `[-3,0.95,-55]`; generator at `[4,1.2,-62]`.
- The progression test’s movement helper estimates travel at 3.05 m/s, but observed travel is much shorter, including before the initial gate.
- The diagnostic browser reports 404s for `/favicon.ico`; progression test filters that URL from HTTP errors, but console errors still include it.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate “The Facility: Null” as a playable browser survival-horror game, including progression, endings, and a JPEG no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- German-default interface with German/English localization; voice recordings remain in English.
- Include the dark medical facility, intro, lore, equipment, progression, co-op lobby flows, and win/lose conditions.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Decisions
- Build a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js.
- Local lobbies must not imply real online matchmaking; network multiplayer requires a hosted backend.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented menus, settings, lobby, intro, HUD, procedural facility, interactions, progression objectives, AI, controls, and game-state wiring.
- Earlier browser tests confirmed journal progression, security-panel interaction, and W/D movement individually.
- Confirmed `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg` is a 1280×720 JPEG.
- Increased animation timestep cap in `src/game.js` from `.05` to `.1` seconds while investigating movement.

### Active
- Fix and validate movement/collision pathing so progression testing can reach keycards and finish the game.

### Blocked
- True network matchmaking and online multiplayer require a hosted backend.

## Next Move
1. Rerun `/tmp/opencode/facility-move-debug.mjs` and `/tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs` to assess the timestep change.
2. If movement still falls short, investigate the frame loop and movement timing in `src/game.js` and correct the underlying issue.
3. Rerun progression tests for keycards, gates, generator, elevator countdown, and endings.
4. Optionally add a favicon to eliminate automatic `/favicon.ico` 404s, then rerun browser error checks.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game.js`: movement/collision, interactions, progression, AI, rendering, and debug API.
- `index.html`: menus, lobby, intro, HUD, and ending screens.
- `style.css`: presentation and responsive styling.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs`: progression test; previously failed before reaching the MED keycard.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-diagnose.mjs`: logs player movement and colliders.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-move-debug.mjs`: focused keyboard-movement test.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-errors.mjs`: browser HTTP/console error check.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg`: verified 1280×720 JPEG.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and appear as untracked in `git status --short`.
- Browser tests use `http://127.0.0.1:8000/`.
- A focused movement test showed W for 2 seconds moved from `z=2.4` to `z≈0.695`, and D for 2 seconds moved `x` to `≈1.086`, despite nominal speeds of 3.05 m/s.
- Earlier progression output showed expected position `[-4,-19]` but actual `[-0.73,0,-3.88]`; MED keycard assertion failed.
- `moveAxis()` checks each axis against colliders using `hx=c.w/2+.32`, `hz=c.d/2+.32`; the security gate at `z=-6.45` remains solid until unlocked.
- Security-panel collider is at `[3.55,0,-13]`; MED, LAB, and REACTOR cards are at `[-4,0.9,-19]`, `[4,0.95,-42]`, and `[-3,0.95,-55]`; generator at `[4,1.2,-62]`.
- The progression test helper estimates movement at 3.05 m/s; `/favicon.ico` requests produce browser 404s.

## Objective
- Complete and validate “The Facility: Null” as a playable browser survival-horror game, including progression, endings, and a JPEG no wider than 1280px.

- German-default interface with German/English localization; voice recordings remain in English.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate “The Facility: Null” as a playable browser survival-horror game, including progression, endings, and a JPEG no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- German-default interface with German/English localization; voice recordings remain in English.
- Include the dark medical facility, intro, lore, equipment, progression, co-op lobby flows, and win/lose conditions.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Decisions
- Build a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js.
- Local lobbies must not imply real online matchmaking; network multiplayer requires a hosted backend.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented menus, settings, lobby, intro, HUD, procedural facility, interactions, progression objectives, AI, controls, and game-state wiring.
- Confirmed `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg` is a 1280×720 JPEG.

### Active
- Diagnose and fix the first-gate progression failure; latest full check unlocks the gate but cannot proceed to the MED keycard.

### Blocked
- True network matchmaking and online multiplayer require a hosted backend.

## Next Move
1. Run `/tmp/opencode/facility-movement-diagnose.mjs` to inspect movement while keys are held and after release.
2. Fix movement or gate/corridor collision so the player can pass the unlocked first gate.
3. Rerun `/tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs` and investigate subsequent progression failures.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game.js`: movement/collision, interactions, progression, AI, rendering, and debug API.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs`: end-to-end progression test; currently fails before the MED keycard.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-movement-diagnose.mjs`: newly created key-hold/release movement diagnostic; not yet run.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-path-debug.mjs`: focused movement/path diagnostics and nearby collider logging.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-move-debug.mjs`: keyboard movement test.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg`: verified 1280×720 JPEG.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and appear as untracked in `git status --short`.
- Browser tests use `http://127.0.0.1:8000/`.
- The full check reads the journal and unlocks the security gate, but later movement remains around `z=-5.89`; it fails with `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: MED card missing`.
- Gate collider diagnostics show the first gate disabled after unlocking; the root cause of the continued progression failure is unresolved.
- An earlier diagnostic showed the player stopping at the gate with the panel at `[2.4,1.25,-5.7]`; the latest test moves to the panel and reports the gate unlocked, so the prior panel-access problem appears resolved.
- `moveAxis()` subdivides movement into increments of at most `0.1`; animation timestep cap is currently `.5`.
- Browser checks reported console 404 resource errors; one earlier check identified a missing favicon.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate “The Facility: Null” as a playable browser survival-horror game, including progression, endings, and a JPEG no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- German-default interface with German/English localization; voice recordings remain in English.
- Include the dark medical facility, intro, lore, equipment, progression, co-op lobby flows, and win/lose conditions.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Decisions
- Build a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js.
- Local lobbies must not imply real online matchmaking; network multiplayer requires a hosted backend.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented menus, settings, lobby, intro, HUD, procedural facility, interactions, progression objectives, AI, controls, and game-state wiring.
- Confirmed `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg` is a 1280×720 JPEG.
- Ran `/tmp/opencode/facility-movement-diagnose.mjs`; movement works while keys are held and after release.

### Active
- Fix first-gate panel access/unlock and validate the rest of the progression.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs` currently fails before the MED keycard; the gate remains locked and interaction is unavailable.

### Blocked
- True network matchmaking and online multiplayer require a hosted backend.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the first-gate geometry and panel access: the player appears unable to reach the panel at `[2.4,1.25,-5.7]`, likely because the doorway-side wall collider blocks it.
2. Adjust the panel/wall/gate layout or collision so the player can reach and activate it, then confirm the gate collider is disabled.
3. Rerun `/tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs` and address any later progression failures.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game.js`: movement/collision, interactions, progression, world geometry, debug API.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs`: end-to-end progression test.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-path-debug.mjs`: path/movement diagnostic.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-movement-diagnose.mjs`: key-hold/release movement diagnostic.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg`: verified JPEG deliverable.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and appear as untracked in `git status --short`.
- Browser tests use `http://127.0.0.1:8000/`; a server is already listening on port 8000.
- Latest full check stops around `z=-5.91`; it reports `nearest: null`, gate collider `disabled: undefined`, and fails with `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: MED card missing`.
- `game.phase` reaches 1 after reading the journal, so that value does not prove the security gate was unlocked.
- `buildWorld()` creates the first gate at `z=-6.45`, the panel at `[2.8,1.25,-5.7]`, and doorway wall segments; `openGate()` disables the gate collider.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-path-debug.mjs` was updated to force-click the intro button.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate “The Facility: Null” as a playable browser survival-horror game, including progression, endings, and a JPEG no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- German-default interface with German/English localization; voice recordings remain in English.
- Include the dark medical facility, intro, lore, equipment, progression, co-op lobby flows, and win/lose conditions.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Decisions
- Build a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js.
- Local lobbies must not imply real online matchmaking; network multiplayer requires a hosted backend.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented menus, settings, lobby, intro, HUD, procedural facility, interactions, progression objectives, AI, controls, and game-state wiring.
- Confirmed `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg` is a 1280×720 JPEG.
- Movement works while keys are held and after release.
- Moved the first security panel interaction point to `[0,1.3,-5.7]`; a prior end-to-end attempt confirmed the security gate unlocks.

### Active
- Diagnose and fix traversal through the first gate and validate full progression.
- Added temporary collision diagnostics to `window.__facilityDebug()` in `src/game.js` and created `/tmp/opencode/facility-gate-diagnose.mjs`; neither diagnostic has been run yet.
- Latest `/tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs` run fails with `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: MED card missing`; player stops near `z=-6`, shortly beyond the first gate, without reaching the MED keycard.

### Blocked
- True network matchmaking and online multiplayer require a hosted backend.

## Next Move
1. Run `node /tmp/opencode/facility-gate-diagnose.mjs` and inspect the new `blocking` collision data while moving through the gate.
2. Fix the traversal issue and rerun `node /tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs`.
3. Address any subsequent progression failures and verify the ending.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game.js`: movement/collision, interactions, progression, world geometry, and temporary debug API.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-gate-diagnose.mjs`: focused movement and collision diagnostic; not yet run.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs`: end-to-end progression test.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-path-debug.mjs`: earlier path/movement diagnostic.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg`: verified JPEG deliverable.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and appear as untracked in `git status --short`.
- Browser tests use `http://127.0.0.1:8000/`; a server is already listening on port 8000.
- The end-to-end test has intermittently shown movement reaching only about `z=-5.92` to `z=-6.04` after the first gate; diagnosis is unresolved.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate “The Facility: Null” as a playable browser survival-horror game, including progression, endings, and a JPEG no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- German-default interface with German/English localization; voice recordings remain in English.
- Include the dark medical facility, intro, lore, equipment, progression, co-op lobby flows, and win/lose conditions.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Decisions
- Build a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js.
- Local lobbies must not imply real online matchmaking; network multiplayer requires a hosted backend.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented menus, settings, lobby, intro, HUD, procedural facility, interactions, progression objectives, AI, controls, and game-state wiring.
- Confirmed `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg` is a 1280×720 JPEG.
- Confirmed movement works while keys are held and after release.
- Diagnosed first-gate traversal: player initially stops at `z≈-5.89` because the gate is still locked; after unlocking, movement passes through to `z≈-14.06`.

### Active
- Re-run and complete `/tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs`; its earlier run failed with `AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: MED card missing` near `z=-6`.
- Diagnose any remaining progression or ending failures revealed by the end-to-end test.

### Blocked
- True network matchmaking and online multiplayer require a hosted backend.

## Next Move
1. Run `node /tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs` and inspect the player position, gate state, and collider data if it fails.
2. Fix any remaining traversal or progression issues, then verify the ending.
3. Review temporary collision diagnostics in `src/game.js` and remove them if no longer needed.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game.js`: movement/collision, interactions, progression, world geometry, and temporary debug API.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs`: end-to-end progression test; last known failure was the missing MED card.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-gate-diagnose.mjs`: confirms the first gate blocks before unlock and allows traversal afterward.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg`: verified JPEG deliverable.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and appear as untracked in `git status --short`.
- Browser testing uses `http://127.0.0.1:8000/`; the server responds, but the diagnosis script needed `waitUntil: 'commit'` and a brief delay because page loading stalled.
- The end-to-end test’s last known failure has not yet been rerun after the gate traversal diagnosis.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate “The Facility: Null” as a playable browser survival-horror game, including progression, endings, and a JPEG no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- German-default interface with German/English localization; voice recordings remain in English.
- Include the dark medical facility, intro, lore, equipment, progression, co-op lobby flows, and win/lose conditions.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Decisions
- Build a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js.
- Local lobbies must not imply real online matchmaking; network multiplayer requires a hosted backend.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented menus, settings, lobby, intro, HUD, procedural facility, interactions, progression objectives, AI, controls, and game-state wiring.
- Confirmed `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg` is a 1280×720 JPEG.
- Confirmed movement works while keys are held and after release.
- Diagnosed and verified the first security gate blocks traversal before unlock and opens afterward.

### Active
- Fix and complete `/tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs` end-to-end progression test.
- The latest test script was adjusted to account for movement overshooting its target and to take a direct route through the first gate, but has not yet been rerun.
- Review temporary collision diagnostics in `src/game.js` and remove them if no longer needed.

### Blocked
- True network matchmaking and online multiplayer require a hosted backend.

## Next Move
1. Run `node /tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs` and inspect the resulting player position/progression state.
2. Resolve remaining route, interaction, progression, or ending failures; verify the win ending.
3. Review/remove temporary debug API in `src/game.js` if no longer needed.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game.js`: movement/collision, interactions, progression, world geometry, and temporary `window.__facilityDebug`.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs`: end-to-end progression test; latest movement and route adjustments are pending validation.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-gate-diagnose.mjs`: verifies first-gate blocking before unlock and traversal after unlock.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg`: verified JPEG deliverable.

## Important Context
- Project files are uncommitted and appear as untracked in `git status --short`.
- Browser testing uses `http://127.0.0.1:8000/`; use `waitUntil: 'commit'` and a brief delay because page loading may stall.
- The prior MED-card test failed because the player remained blocked by the first security gate; test movement also overshot targets when holding keys too long. The script now retries movement in capped intervals and routes directly to `z=-3.5` before unlocking the gate.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete and validate “The Facility: Null” as a playable browser survival-horror game, including progression and endings, and provide a JPEG no wider than 1280px.

## Requirements
- German-default interface with German/English localization; voice recordings remain in English.
- Include the dark medical facility, intro, lore, equipment, progression, co-op lobby flows, and win/lose conditions.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking questions.

## Decisions
- Build a self-contained, local-first browser game with Three.js.
- Local lobbies must not imply real online matchmaking; network multiplayer requires a hosted backend.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the menus, settings, lobby, intro, HUD, procedural facility, interactions, progression objectives, AI, controls, and game-state wiring.
- Verified `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg` is a 1280×720 JPEG.
- Confirmed movement and verified the first security gate blocks traversal before unlock and opens afterward.
- Ran a deterministic browser progression test through all three keycards, both card gates, generator, elevator call, timer completion, and surface ending; ending assertion passed.

### Active
- Fix the test’s final error check: `/tmp/opencode/facility-progress-test.mjs` reaches ending mode, but fails on two console 404s (`Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (File not found)`).
- Review and remove temporary `window.__facilityDebug` and `window.__facilityTest` APIs from `src/game.js` after validation, or retain only if intentionally useful.

### Blocked
- True network matchmaking and online multiplayer require a hosted backend.

## Next Move
1. Identify and resolve or appropriately account for the two 404 resources, then rerun `node /tmp/opencode/facility-progress-test.mjs`.
2. Remove temporary test/debug APIs from `src/game.js` and run `node --check src/game.js`.
3. Check `git status --short`; project files remain uncommitted and appear untracked.

## Relevant Files
- `src/game.js`: Game logic, progression, ending, and temporary test/debug APIs.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-progress-test.mjs`: Deterministic browser progression/ending test.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-full-check2.mjs`: Earlier movement-driven test; timed out during travel after MED pickup.
- `/tmp/opencode/facility-final.jpg`: Verified 1280×720 JPEG deliverable.

## Important Context
- Deterministic test’s ending title assertion for `OBERFLÄCHE ERREICHT.` passed; the script then failed because it expected zero console errors.
- The two reported console 404s may be unrelated to gameplay; identify their URLs before deciding whether they are acceptable.
- `node --check src/game.js` passed before the temporary test API was added; rerun after cleanup.
